 .;Sets up initial program for JCD Deficiency report, allows user input
 .;defining parameters/prompts, calls compilated VA Software utilities
 .;to generate report.

e0e695b7: ;If the option to divide output by medical services (DGJTMUL) is selected, call the DIVISION^VAUTOMA routine to allow the user to specify division selections. Quit the program if the user aborts (-1).
6a569145: ;If not dividing output by medical services, set the file pointer (DGJTDV) to the Institution file (#40.8).
14dee6d6: ;Execute the compiled entry pointed to by the DGJTL variable (which defines selection criteria). Quit the program if the user aborts (-1).
a2229520: ;Call the DAT^DGJPDEF routine to set up date prompts/ranges. Quit the program if the user aborts (-1).

f491aeee: ;Set up variables to call the FIRST^VAUTOMA routine, which will allow the user to select a 'deficiency' print template. VAUTVB is the array root for storing selected template IEN, DIC is the global root for finding templates, VAUTSTR is the template search string, and VAUTNI=2 indicates this is a listman-style selection. Quit the program if the user aborts (-1).
b482214a: ;Call the ASK1^DGJPDEF routine to prompt for any additional report parameters. Quit the program if the user aborts (-1).
59185a38: ;Inform the user that this report requires 132 column output.
d75e20aa: ;Get the current date/time and format it into an external FileMan date (VADAT("E")) to be used as the 'PRINTED ON' date for the report header.

a3367fcd: ;Set DGVAR to contain a list of all variables that should be passed to the ^DGJUTQ routine for Kernel's ZISTCP call. Set DGPGM to the routine entry point to start after the ZISTCP call. Call ZIS^DGJUTQ to allow the user to select a printer/output device. If the user doesn't abort (POP=0), send output to the selected device and branch to START^DGJPDEF1 to generate the report.
b873b918: ;Exit point for when the user aborts or the report completes.
b4043d24: Loop through the file #393 and check each entry.
290ba0f9: If printing the Long or Sorted Long format and the ^TMP array is defined, clear variables and go to the appropriate routine to print the report.
5c72aca2: If printing the Summary format and the ^TMP array is defined, clear variables and go to the routine to print the summary report.
cbc61bb6: If the ^TMP array is not defined, print a message indicating no records.
43c20438: Quit and return to the DGJPDEF routine.
